recording.source: Original executable SOUND runtime in DOSBox 0.74-3; instrumentation logs arguments; temporary copy waits after final effect to permit recording
recording.observed: DOSBox recording shows state-dependent phase and speaker-disable transitions. Version 01.03 adds a stateful PIT/gate and acoustic-response model; raw PIT reference remains separate for parser tests.
recording.limitation: DOSBox output is an emulation, not a measurement of an IBM 5150 speaker or Vita speakers.

model.count_reload: at half-period edge, preserving phase while enabled
model.acoustic_response: 3rd-order Butterworth high-pass 120 Hz and low-pass 4300 Hz
model.limitation: Representative small PC-speaker response, not measurement of an individual IBM 5150. Nominal score durations retained; exact initial DOS IRQ phase not reproduced.

listening_examples.order: Three empty-cell impulses followed by three wall impulses; 0.5 s between events.
